children: Dialog's upstream earnings outlook appears positive with the commencement of gas production from the Salbiah field, a key milestone, providing a new recurring earnings stream, says Hong Leong IB analyst Thye May Ting in a note. The Salbiah field is estimated to contribute 27 million ringgit in annual net profit from FY2027. The subsequent start-up of the Fatimah field by end-2028 could add to Dialog's earnings, bringing annual contribution from both fields to an estimated 61 million ringgit from FY2029. The bulk of Salbiah's development capex has been completed, with spending expected to moderate to maintenance levels, supporting cash flow generation, she adds. Hong Leong maintains a buy rating and keeps its target price at 2.49 ringgit. Shares are unchanged at 1.91 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
